stories.title: Warsh wants the Fed to say less. Two officials are pushing for more transparency.
stories.summary: More interest-rate hikes are needed to fight inflation, Fed officials say.

stories.title: In a wild October for markets, these stocks were the biggest winners and losers
stories.summary: Many Big Tech stocks were hit hard but the S&P 500 showed strength under the surface, with a majority of stocks showing gains for the month.

stories.title: Why Intel’s stock saw its worst day in decades — and a $140 billion wipeout
stories.summary: Intel’s PC business is under pressure as memory-chip prices dent demand and as corporate IT teams have less budget for laptops.

stories.title: Criminal investigation of Alaska Senate race is 'ongoing,' U.S. Attorney says

stories.title: Trump admin again loses bid to block California from counting alleged noncitizen votes
stories.summary: A US appeals court on Friday rejected the Trump admin's request that it temporarily block the state from counting mail ballots from more than 20,000 registered voters. A US appeals court on Friday rejected the Trump administration's request that it temporarily block California from counting any mail ballots for the November 3 midterm elections…

stories.title: Reddit’s stock logs its biggest one-day drop ever. It’s not the last of the bad news, analysts say.
stories.summary: Reddit’s stock plunged on Friday after the community-discussion forum said its search referral traffic was down significantly in the third quarter.

stories.title: Intel stock has worst day since 1970s, wiping about $12 billion off government's stake
stories.summary: Intel shares fell 29% on Friday and headed for their worst day since the 1970s. The chipmaker issued weaker-than-expected guidance, citing ongoing softness in the PC market. Amazon also sold off following an earnings miss.

stories.title: Microsoft is winning the cloud wars and becoming Wall Street’s new golden child
stories.summary: Various factors indicate that Microsoft is in a better financial position than its cloud rivals, analysts say.
